title: Sip History in Music City Cocktail Making Class
includes: Guided instruction by a professional mixologist
Gratuities for the instructor or staff (not included)
Additional drinks beyond the three included (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Combines hands-on bartending with a journey through the city's storied bootlegging and cocktail history. In your intimate retro bar setting, you'll shake and stir three different cocktails with guidance from a local expert, learn the stories behind Tennessee whiskey and other spirits, and enjoy curated bar snacks.

Every guest has the chance to step behind a real bar and make a cocktail! (3 cocktails included). Be ready for jokes, stories, history, pro tips on drinks, and interactive drink making.
